conclusions: All four handler forms iterate the !dead roster in input order; HP0 alone does not remove a player from this client roster.
287 calls the direct disease widget setter: an existing Cold/Fever/Hell/Heaven is replaced by Fever without upgrade, Heavenfall or HP change. Other curses remain.
288 is idempotent for existing Fog, then asks the alive participating local viewer to hide alive enemy panes; spectator/dead viewers do not initiate that Fog animation.
290 assigns the supplied HP text directly, without delta clamp, direct-damage departure, death/revival, tick or gift logic. Its fixed model metadata is1.

294 sums all live CP, writes every live CP0, then calls recipient.bc(total), which caps positive CP99; a live recipient is included in the sum once. Renderer lookup does not itself enforce a live recipient or atomic failure.

A.to maps guardian values then filters out null/unknown/nonstrings.296 consumes one surviving recognized guardian per live player; dead players consume no entry. Short decoded arrays throw after earlier changes, extra decoded entries remain. Raw null is not an explicit clear slot: standalone sd0(null) can clear, but this JSON array decoder removes null first.
Hidden Fog overlays do not prevent these underlying widget updates. Internal state mutation is not proof of public fanout permission for types, quantities or hidden panes.
limitations: The adapter shape annotations are local input-shape checks only. They do not prove server acceptance or a nonterminal/main-boundary runtime state for every deliberately adversarial UI scene.

Exact known non-null guardian arrays, live-recipient checks and atomic rejection are intentional adapter restrictions stronger than the renderer. Raw nullable/unknown/short/extra arrays are rejected even when filtering would make their decoded UI list usable.
The source receiver does not establish207 selection, outcome probability, guardian lifecycle, death/rescue, timing, GF, ordinary owner, response/counter queues or any automatic schedule.

Resource text/widgets, DOM animation, sound, Future scheduling and Fog pane presentation are stubbed; event decoder, receiver control flow, roster filtering, curse replacement, resource cascade and guardian replacement execute unchanged.
No backend, account, DOM, timer or Dart application startup runs. Do not expose the recorded raw CP sums or guardian arrays as public execution diagnostics.
